source: IMG_9658.jpeg, IMG_9659.jpeg (native), IMG_9660.jpeg (previous Altboard), IMG_9669.jpeg (current Altboard screenshot), IMG_9670.jpeg (native 3-column prediction screenshot)
measurement: Approximate pixel measurements normalized at inferred 3x; not Apple layout APIs

touchTarget.reason: Each letter key has a larger, contiguous hitbox while the key graphics retain visible 6pt spacing. This is an approximation of native iOS behavior, not a private UIKit algorithm.

alphabetic.microphoneInHistory: When the History test field is focused, request dictation using the existing in-app Darwin bridge. No deep link or app switch.
alphabetic.keyboardDismissGesture: No custom edge swipe; removed after real-device test. Host app handles outside taps.
alphabetic.personalizedCandidates: Offline dictionary selectionCounts stored in App Group; most frequently chosen candidate within the query results is shown first.

spaceBarIndicator.scope: Only Alphabet letter page; hidden on numeric/symbol pages

emojiKey.style: filled white face (SF Symbols; native screenshot visual approximation)

alphabetic.keyPressVisual: Touch-down and quick-release highlight; dark pressed #787878 (120/255) vs default #434343 (67/255), currently a visual prototype
alphabetic.symbolSpaceReturn: After typing a nonnumber symbol in the Alphabet numeric/symbol subpage, Space inserts one space and returns to Alphabet letters; digits keep the numeric page.

cantoneseExpandedCandidates.disclosure: 29pt right-side chevron toggles a 4-column, vertically scrolling candidate grid
cantoneseExpandedCandidates.ranking: exact single-character readings -> exact phrases -> prefix candidates; local selection frequency within group
cantoneseExpandedCandidates.alias: Untoned ng may offer 唔 as extra user-friendly alias for standard m4; canonical stored romanization remains m4
cantoneseExpandedCandidates.toneDigits: Strict tone-aware search retained; no alias when tone digit typed
cantoneseExpandedCandidates.editing: Host text suffix verified before replacement, no raw typed-content trace

visualAlignment.note: IMG_9674 and IMG_9675 have matching 1320px widths and 3x inferred scale; these measurements are observed pixels, not an Apple published spec. Host presentation can affect absolute keyboard position.
visualAlignment.nativeHeightTarget: Screenshot-relative goal: remove extra 39px (~13pt) bottom gap; keep content at 274pt

compositionBehavior.latin: English/German or another preferred language with an installed UITextChecker locale; full-width predictions during active typing; typed Latin remains in host

predictionStrip.candidateBehavior: Latin typed string first, optional OK correction, then ordered offline Cantonese suggestions with user selection frequency ranking
predictionStrip.note: Glyph median measured around RGB(162,162,162) in IMG_9658 and IMG_9670; keyboard rectangle and glyph metrics are estimates from actual screenshots, not Apple public internals.

locales.offlineMechanism: UITextChecker.availableLanguages plus small built-in English/German fallback list
locales.persistence: App Group selection frequency, no upload

touchTargeting.rowSurface: one DragGesture per alphabet row (not one per key)
touchTargeting.hitArea: contiguous row bands; includes 6pt visual horizontal gaps and half vertical 11pt gaps
touchTargeting.debug: Settings > Help > Diagnostics > Keyboard Touch Diagnostics > Show Key Touch Areas. Orange = touch; dashed cyan = visible
touchTargeting.model: language-matched offline completion suggestions; Jyutping only when romanization selected is Jyutping; no unverified Yale mapping
touchTargeting.note: Implementation is inspired by open source, not the native Apple hit-testing algorithm; testing and calibration remain necessary

keyboardBackdropObservedRGB.conclusion: Same dominant base backdrop sampled from screenshots. Do not arbitrarily change #1F1F1F; adjust key fill/insets and test host corner blending.

measuredDeltasPt.nativeFirstAndLastKeysSymmetric: Yes within approx. 1px after correcting inset

changes.numericThirdRow: #+= or 123; no duplicated ABC, ABC remains bottom-left

latestScreenshotComparison.symbolReference: IMG_9676.jpeg native numeric keyboard: top 1-0, second punctuation, third #+= punctuation backspace, bottom ABC Emoji Space Return
latestScreenshotComparison.visualReliability: Approximate geometry from screenshots; no claim of 100% Apple private parity
